title: Quaint Crunchy Northern Thai Tofu Noodles
description: A jammy and crunchy vegan-friendly dish featuring creme-patissiere and tadka, inspired by the nostalgic flavors of Northern Thailand
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add the tadka spices
Add the cubed tofu to the pan and cook until golden brown on all sides
In a small bowl, whisk together the creme-patissiere and soy sauce
Add the cooked noodles to the pan with the tofu and stir to combine
Pour the creme-patissiere mixture over the noodles and tofu
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly
Transfer the noodles to a serving dish and top with chopped scallions and crushed peanuts
